title: A DEVOTION THAT DOES NOT GROW WEARY

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "On the third day offer eleven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect... On the fourth day offer ten bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect... On the fifth day offer nine bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect." - Num 29:20-28 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
As the feast went on, the number of bulls decreased by one each day, from thirteen on the first day down through the week. Yet the offerings continued faithfully, day after day, without interruption. Each day still brought its rams, lambs, grain, drink, and sin offerings. The rhythm of worship was steady and unbroken through the whole festival.

There is quiet instruction in this steady, ongoing pattern. Worship was not meant to be exhausting bursts followed by long silences, but a sustained walking with God through the days. Even as the specifics shifted, the people kept turning to the Lord. Their devotion did not grow weary as the days passed.

We can grow tired in our walk with God, especially when the excitement of a new beginning fades into the ordinary. Yet God calls us to keep going, to keep worshipping, to keep coming to Him even when it feels routine. The steady, unwearied devotion of ordinary days is precious in His sight.

The good news is that our faithfulness rests on His. Christ never grows weary, and He carries us when we are tired. Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength and not grow faint (Isa 40:31). Let these repeated offerings remind you that God is honoured by a devotion that keeps going, and that His strength sustains you through every ordinary, faithful day.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you grow weary when your walk with God feels routine?
2. How can you keep worshipping faithfully through ordinary days?
3. What does it mean that God renews the strength of those who hope in Him?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, when my walk with You feels routine and I grow weary, renew my strength. Help me keep coming to You faithfully through every ordinary day, sustained by Your never-failing power. Amen.
